reasoningChain.evidence: The confluence is available after both trials, but the last win took 49.6 seconds and lost one ally.
The active warrior supplied 43.94% of flag-trial damage, making it a proven target for a physical upgrade.

The mythic level-27 gloves have physical power, armor, armor break, crit, execute damage, and repeated low-health damage; their visible empty-slot fit is 285.2, far above the warrior's current older rare level-13 gloves' earlier 106.8 fit.
The mythic gloves can legally replace the warrior's current gloves while keeping the confirmed priest lineup.
Equipping them to the inactive knight would require another roster change, while the active warrior already proved central to the long trial win.
